title: Fresh Tea
bio: Fresh is an 19 year old tea addicted art student from Sweden who’s specialised in stylised equine art, but is also currently working on being able to draw other species and humans too. Once she graduates she hopes to become a professional illustrator and concept artist, but she’s open to see what the future has in hold for her. If you’d like to support her on her journey, check her out on Instagram as that’s where she’s the most active! Her dms are always open if you’d like to send her a message
